# Binary One Solutions

> Binary One Solutions Ltd is a Nairobi-based technology consultancy helping
> medium-sized and larger Kenyan and East African organisations professionalise
> IT, prepare for ERP, and build practical digital products. Primary services:
> Managed IT with a Virtual CIO, vendor-neutral ERP consulting, and Digital
> Products (NAWIRI digital loyalty, Agentic AI workflows, custom software).

- Location: St Charles Lwanga House, Ngong Road, Nairobi, Kenya
- Contact: info@binaryone.co.ke · +254 787 990 220
- Primary call to action: Book a Free IT Assessment

## Services

- [Managed IT](https://binaryone.co.ke/managed-it): Virtual CIO strategy, a named IT Operations Lead, helpdesk, cybersecurity and technology governance (the AIM-IT methodology).
- [ERP Consulting](https://binaryone.co.ke/erp-consulting): Independent, vendor-neutral ERP readiness, selection and implementation governance (Odoo, SAP, Microsoft Dynamics, Sage).
- [Digital Products](https://binaryone.co.ke/digital-products): Overview of NAWIRI, Agentic AI and Custom Software.
- [NAWIRI Digital Loyalty](https://binaryone.co.ke/digital-products/nawiri): Mobile-first loyalty and last-mile intelligence platform (used by Crown Paints and Isuzu East Africa).
- [Agentic AI Workflows](https://binaryone.co.ke/digital-products/agentic-ai): Autonomous reasoning agents that act on existing ERP/business systems.
- [Custom Software](https://binaryone.co.ke/digital-products/custom-software): Bespoke high-performance enterprise systems.

## Why Binary One Solutions (differentiators)

- Founded 2014; Nairobi-based, serving Kenya and East Africa.
- Every engagement has two named, accountable people — a Virtual CIO plus a named IT Operations Lead — not a faceless ticket queue.
- ERP advice is vendor-neutral and independent of any software licence sale, so recommendations follow the evidence, not reseller commission.
- Governance-led delivery using the AIM-IT methodology (Assess, Implement, Manage, Improve) and NIST/COBIT-informed IT audit.
- AI-forward: real, governed Agentic AI workflows with a human approving every high-stakes step.
- Advisor and shareholder: Prof. Edwin Kairu, Distinguished Service Professor at Carnegie Mellon University (AI research and cybersecurity).

## Proof and clients

- NAWIRI digital loyalty is used by manufacturers including Crown Paints (Team Kubwa) and Isuzu East Africa (MAXIT); it has driven 30%+ sales growth for a listed manufacturer in its first year.
- Selected clients: Isuzu East Africa, Vivo Fashion Group, Rhombus Concrete, Pacific Petroleum, Tosha Energy, Royal Oven Tanzania, African Eagle, KN Law LLP, Ahmednasir Abdullahi Advocates LLP, KELIN, Kenya Meat Commission, Nairobi City County, PEMBE Millers, Mogo Finance, International Safety & Training Centre.
